verdict.rationale: LocalAI's homepage lists "vision" among the modalities its runtime supports, which is a first-party claim of vision capability. Nothing in the pack shows how image inputs are passed alongside text, which vision-language models or backends are supported, or how to use them through the OpenAI-compatible API. missing for 10: documentation of image+text multimodal chat input, list of supported VLM models/backends, API usage examples, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
